notes.subject: עזים
notes.rationale: שעיר עזים 'he-goat of goats' — the genitive is elliptical emphasis; rendered simply as 'batakɛ' (he-goat).

notes.subject: ⟨la⟩
notes.rationale: Bamanankan needs a postposition where Hebrew's bare על 'upon/besides' carries the sense 'in addition to'.

notes.subject: tamid
notes.rationale: התמיד 'the continual (sacrifice)' is rendered by the technical term tamid rather than the full phrase 'saraka min bɛ tugu taa bɛɛ'.

notes.subject: kelen
notes.rationale: The verse counts the offering precisely — one he-goat — part of the sacrificial schedule of Numbers 28.

translation: Ni batakɛ kelen ye jurumu-saraka ye Yawe ma; a bɛ kɛ ka tɛmɛ ⟨la⟩ tamid saraka-ɲagami kan, ni a ka nesek ye.
